title: Right Diagnosis, Unsafe Route: Auditing Clinical AI Decision Trajectories and Corrective Oversight for Validity and Potential Harm
abstract: arXiv:2611.22612v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A clinical AI system can reach a correct final diagnosis through intermediate decisions that could have harmed the patient, and can repair an error while introducing new risks. Most evaluations score final diagnoses; even stepwise benchmarks, which release a case's evidence over time, score whether systems reach the right diagnosis or gather the right information, not whether the decisions a patient passes through are safe. We make patient safety the target of stepwise evaluation. A trajectory audit replays real admissions checkpoint by checkpoint, lets each system decide with only the evidence released so far, and rates every test, treatment and disposition for its potential harm to the patient and, separately, for clinical validity, against the documented final diagnosis and physician-written disease rubrics yet on the evidence available when the decision was made. An LLM judge scores every decision, and a physician reference standard

translated_title: 正确的诊断，不安全的路径：审计临床AI决策轨迹及纠正性监督的有效性与潜在危害
translated_abstract: 临床AI系统可能通过原本会伤害患者的中间决策达到正确的最终诊断，也可能在修复错误的同时引入新的风险。大多数评估方法只对最终诊断进行打分；即使是逐步式基准测试（即随时间推移逐步发布病例证据的测试），也只评估系统能否得出正确诊断或收集正确信息，而不评估患者所经历的每一步决策是否安全。我们将患者安全作为逐步评估的目标。轨迹审计方法逐个检查点重放真实住院病例，让每个系统仅基于目前 released 的证据进行决策，并对每项检查、治疗和处置进行评分——分别评估其对患者的潜在危害，以及临床有效性（对照记录在案的最终诊断和医生撰写的疾病评分标准，但仅基于决策时可获得的证据）。LLM评判器对每项决策进行评分，医生参考标准……
tldr: 该论文提出“轨迹审计”方法，通过逐检查点重放真实住院病例，对临床AI每一步中间决策的患者潜在危害和临床有效性分别评分，弥补了传统评估只关注最终诊断正确性而忽视决策路径安全性的缺陷。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a trajectory audit that replays real hospital admissions checkpoint by checkpoint, scoring every intermediate decision of clinical AI systems for both potential patient harm and clinical validity, addressing the gap left by conventional evaluations that only assess final diagnostic correctness.
